	add = 100

	add = 1

			NOT = { has_variable = pp_lplan_g_copper }
			OR = { has_building = building_type:copper_mine_deep has_building = building_type:copper_mine_adit has_building = building_type:copper_mine }
		}
		value = 1
	}
}

# shows while this is above 0: the tiles the row has left after the marks and the candidates of the chunks
# before it, minus a whole chunk, plus 1.
